substantive_scope.unavailable: Individual data, analysis code, registration record, literature review and references; target journal was not specified.

confirmed_errors: C1: Failure to reject a difference does not establish equivalence.
C3: Different within-group significance labels do not establish a between-group difference.
verification_requests: C2: Handling of class-level randomization, school blocking and small-cluster inference.
C4: Definition and estimation of standardized adjusted contrast.
C5: Evidence for comparable exposure time and operationalization of the contrast.
C6: Treatment assignments and experience of questionnaire respondents.
preserved_valid_arguments: Discussion recognizes primary-effect uncertainty and a potentially meaningful positive difference.
Feasibility findings are restricted to respondents and distinguished from motivation.
Preparation-time/resources recommendation is conditional and justified by implementation tasks, not a superiority claim.
review_decisions.sample_counts: 118 + 122 = 240, consistent with the abstract; no sample-count error alleged.
